state.goal: Report production defects per 1,000 items, excluding trial records, with source support.
state.source_shape: Three rows with integer items and defects; production and trial kinds are explicit.
state.risk: A wrong rate would be detectable by code; no external action is requested.

route.instructions: Choose the least resource-intensive route that can satisfy the stated task and validation requirement. Deterministic is appropriate when executable checks can settle the answer. A direct worker may be enough for a bounded text task. Use the five-unit checked network when evidence complexity or the required review policy justifies its repeated Jev and Sol-high calls. Do not use model confidence alone as proof.

criteria.deterministic: Compute from original evidence with exact code checks; no generative worker or Sol-high checker. Keep source references.
criteria.direct_worker: Use one GPT-6 Luna or Sol worker with an explicit task-specific validator and no claim of five-unit checking.
criteria.checked_five_unit: Run the full five-unit graph with Jev authorization and a Sol-high check after each unit.
criteria.retrieve_evidence: Stop to obtain missing original evidence before selecting a computation route.
criteria.stop: Stop because no offered route can meet the constraints safely.
